title: pkix-identity remaining work
description: Remaining issues from PKIX-68mt review pass. 3 P1 items still open (after rm8 fixed accessors, PartialEq, and NotYetImplemented).
close_reason:
All three children are closed: bue.2 (ASCII MailboxName vs SmtpUTF8Mailbox rustdoc) and bue.3 (find_san took the first SAN extension, duplicates silently ignored) earlier, bue.1 (no 'static escape hatch — the gap was really Hash/Ord for cache keys) now. The description's '3 P1 items still open' is satisfied; nothing else is linked.

Everything shipped: bue.3 in pkix-identity 0.3.0 (published, with pkix-dane 0.3.0 and pkix-chain 0.8.0 so the duplicate-SAN rejection is reachable through the umbrellas), bue.1 in 0.3.1 (unpublished).
